observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: television studio stage with colorful lit backdrop and circular floor pattern, seated audience and judges watching
observation.dancers: one male and one female dancer, couple
observation.formation_and_space: couple performing folk-style choreography, traveling in circles and facing each other on stage
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture with engaged core, knees slightly soft for stepping and stamping
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic footwork including stamps, heel clicks, and cross-steps synchronized with the upbeat music; rapid zapateo visible on close-ups
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held curved overhead or out to the sides; hands often snapping or gesturing; skirts manipulated dynamically by both dancers
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright with graceful turns and pivots; occasional upper body leans during partner moves
observation.partnering: non-contact partnering with coordinated mirroring, intermittent close holds and arm wraps, leading and following transitions
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent turns, fast spins, floor drops, and low knee bends during zapateo sections
observation.costume_and_props: female wears a long patterned floral skirt with ruffled hem and heeled character shoes, hair in braided style with flowers; male wears a white shirt, red patterned sash, dark trousers, and tall boots with spurs
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer details obscured by rapid cutting and wide camera angles

signature_moments.what: Dancers enter the circular stage with high kicks and dynamic leg extensions in opposite directions.
Couple performs a synchronized circular turn while holding handkerchiefs or skirt corners high overhead.
Male dancer performs intricate zapateo footwork while dropping to one knee.
Female dancer spins rapidly while waving a folded textile garment above her head.
